title: Discovery of Emodin as a novel competitive KPC-2 inhibitor through virtual screening: Synergistic efficacy with Meropenem against Carbapenem-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae infection.
authors: Wang, Yan; Geng, Jiamin; Li, Bingyan; Deng, Xuming; Wang, Jiaxi; Guo, Na
one_liner_zh: 通过虚拟筛选和分子动力学模拟发现天然化合物大黄素作为KPC-2蛋白竞争性抑制剂，并验证其与美罗培南的协同抗菌效果，涉及蛋白质结构对接与MD模拟，但核心是药物发现而非蛋白质结构计算方法创新。
abstract: Carbapenem-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae produces the carbapenemase KPC-2, which rapidly confers resistance and poses a significant threat to public health worldwide. Natural compounds have broad application potential, novel structures, and are not easily recognized by existing bacterial resistance mechanisms. Therefore, through virtual screening based on the KPC-2 protein structure and in vitro antimicrobial assessment, the natural anthraquinone compound emodin was identified as a KPC-2 inhibitor (IC(50) = 24.4 muM) and a synergist of meropenem. Molecular dynamics simulation and interaction analyses indicated that emodin competitively occupied the active site of KPC-2 at Trp105 and Thr237, resulting in reduced alpha-helices and increased beta-sheets, thereby inhibiting KPC-2 activity. The combination of emodin and MEM exhibited a synergistic effect. Furthermore, emodin modulates succinate dehydrogenase (SDH) activity and its transcriptional expression, resulting in metabolic perturbation that renders bacteria susceptible to meropenem, thereby potentiating the synergistic antibacterial activity of the combination. This disrupted the metabolic homeostasis of the bacteria, thereby compromising the integrity of bacterial cells and biofilms. No resistance development was observed over 30 generations of passage. In a mouse model of pneumonia, the combination therapy significantly reduced MEM usage, decreased the pulmonary bacterial load by 1.43 log CFU/g of model group, attenuated lung inflammation, and restored normal lung histology. These findings suggest that emodin acts as a promising candidate of KPC-2 inhibitor, which is capable of reinstating carbapenem efficacy against carbapenem-resistant Gram-negative pathogens in vitro and in vivo.
abstract_zh: 耐碳青霉烯肺炎克雷伯菌（Carbapenem-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae）产生碳青霉烯酶KPC-2，该酶可快速赋予耐药性，对全球公共卫生构成重大威胁。天然化合物具有广泛的应用潜力、新颖的结构，且不易被现有细菌耐药机制识别。因此，通过基于KPC-2蛋白结构的虚拟筛选（virtual screening）及体外抗菌评估，天然蒽醌化合物大黄素（emodin）被鉴定为KPC-2抑制剂（IC(50) = 24.4 μM）及美罗培南（meropenem）的增效剂。分子动力学模拟（molecular dynamics simulation）及相互作用分析表明，大黄素竞争性占据KPC-2活性位点Trp105和Thr237，导致α-螺旋减少、β-折叠增加，从而抑制KPC-2活性。大黄素与MEM联用表现出协同效应。此外，大黄素调节琥珀酸脱氢酶（succinate dehydrogenase, SDH）活性及其转录表达，引起代谢紊乱，使细菌对美罗培南敏感，从而增强联合用药的协同抗菌活性。这破坏了细菌的代谢稳态，进而损害细菌细胞及生物被膜的完整性。在30代传代过程中未观察到耐药性产生。在肺炎小鼠模型中，联合治疗显著减少MEM用量，使模型组肺部细菌载量降低1.43 log CFU/g，减轻肺部炎症，并恢复肺组织正常组织学结构。这些发现表明，大黄素作为KPC-2抑制剂的有前景候选物，能够在体外和体内恢复碳青霉烯类药物对耐碳青霉烯革兰阴性病原菌的疗效。
